title: axup rulebook
description: Schema for github.com/AxGrid/axup rulebook.yaml — used by IDE YAML language servers for autocomplete and validation. Reference: doc/rulebook-reference.md.

name.description: Rulebook identifier. Doubles as the remote state-dir name (~/.axup-state/<name>/state.json).

vars.description: Default template variables. Per-host inventory vars, --vars file, and git auto-vars (git_sha, git_short_sha, git_branch, git_dirty) override these.

history.description: Per-file rollback history depth. When >0, copy/template archive the previous body on each overwrite; `axup rollback` restores from the chain; `axup history clear` wipes it. 0 (default) disables capture.

deps.description: External rulebook dependencies fetched via git, locked in axup.lock.

secrets.description: Declarative list of files managed by `axup secrets`.

recipients_file.description: Path to age recipients file. Defaults: recipients.txt, then .axup/recipients.txt.

files.description: Files (relative to rulebook dir) encrypted via `axup secrets encrypt`. Each entry is either a bare path string or a {path, recipients?, format?} mapping for per-file overrides.

recipients.description: Override SecretsSpec.recipients_file for this file only.

format.description: Force the encryption backend. '' / 'auto' (default) picks by extension: sops for yaml/yml/json/ini/env/toml, age otherwise. 'age' forces whole-file age regardless of extension — use this when recipients are ssh-* keys (sops only accepts age1… recipients). 'sops' forces sops (only valid for structured extensions).

decrypted_to.description: Plaintext working-copy path. When set, the entry switches to pair mode: `path` is the encrypted file committed to git, `decrypted_to` is the plaintext file gitignored & generated by `axup secrets unseal`. `axup secrets seal` does the reverse. `encrypt`/`decrypt` skip pair entries (with a hint).

tasks.description: Module-form rulebook only — a single reusable task list imported via `use:`. Cannot coexist with phase keys (bootstrap, deploy, …).

services.description: Catalog of services consumed by `axup logs <name>`. Pure metadata — does NOT manage processes.

logs.description: Log file path(s) on the remote. Templated against rb.Vars.

^(?!name$|vars$|deps$|secrets$|tasks$|se.description: A phase — runnable via `axup run <name>`. Names `bootstrap` and `deploy` get the dedicated `axup bootstrap` / `axup deploy` subcommands.

git.description: Repo URL: github.com/foo/bar, https://…, or git@…

task.description: Exactly one of: command, copy, template, mkdir, symlink, remove, user, group, chmod, chown, download, apt, service, docker_install, docker_compose, docker_build, docker_login, mysql_database, pg_database, use.

name.description: Human-readable label shown in CLI output.

when_changed.description: Run only if any of these remote paths changed earlier in this phase. Invalid on copy/template/mkdir/symlink/remove/chmod/chown/download (each one stats its path and decides skip-vs-apply on its own).

command.description: Shell command run via /bin/sh -c on the remote. Use the string shorthand for a one-liner or the object form to add when/unless predicates and ignore_errors.

vars.description: Vars passed to the imported module (only valid with `use:`).

run.description: Shell command body (multi-line strings are passed to /bin/sh -c).

when.description: Run the body only when this shell predicate exits 0. Mutually exclusive with unless.

unless.description: Run the body only when this shell predicate exits non-zero. Mutually exclusive with when.

ignore_errors.description: Non-zero exit becomes status=changed with an 'ignored exit=N' message instead of error.

src.description: Local source path relative to rulebook dir.

name.description: Package name or list of packages.

dockerInstall.description: Install Docker Engine via the get.docker.com convenience script. Skipped if `docker --version` already succeeds.

pull.description: `docker compose pull` before the state action.

wait.description: Append --wait to `docker compose up` — block until healthchecks pass. state: up only.

mkdir.description: Create a directory on the remote (always mkdir -p). Mode/owner/group are reconciled only when explicitly set — omitted attributes use 0755 on create and are left alone on existing dirs. Shorthand: `mkdir: /path` is sugar for `mkdir: { path: /path }`.

owner.description: Username; resolved on the remote via /etc/passwd.

symlink.description: Create/update a symbolic link. Idempotent: skipped when dst already points at src.

force.description: Replace an existing regular file or directory at dst. Default true matches `ln -sfn`.

remove.description: Delete a path. Idempotent — absent → skipped. Shorthand: `remove: /path` is sugar for `remove: { path: /path }`.

recursive.description: Required for non-empty directories. Default false to avoid `rm -rf` accidents.

user.description: Create or delete a system user. MVP scope: exists-or-not + supplementary-group reconciliation. Shorthand: `user: app` is sugar for `user: { name: app }`.

create_home.description: Pair with home: to actually mkdir it (--create-home).

groups.description: Supplementary groups. Reconciled via usermod -aG each run.

group.description: Create or delete a system group. Shorthand: `group: docker` is sugar for `group: { name: docker }`.

chmod.description: Set POSIX mode on an existing path. Idempotent — only chmod's when current mode differs.

chown.description: Set owner/group on an existing path. At least one of owner/group is required.

recursive.description: Walk the tree with chown -RP semantics (Lchown — never follows symlinks).

download.description: HTTP GET → file on the remote. Optional sha256 verification; without it an existing file is trusted.

headers.description: Custom HTTP headers (e.g. Authorization). Values are templated through rb.Vars.

creds_file.description: Path to a YAML file (possibly age-encrypted) with username/password.

mysqlDatabase.description: CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS via the `mysql` CLI on the remote. Optionally also CREATE USER + GRANT ALL when `user` is set. Admin password is passed through the MYSQL_PWD env var (never on argv). Idempotent via information_schema.SCHEMATA + mysql.user lookups; charset/collation drift on an existing DB is NOT reconciled.

name.description: Database name. Constrained to ASCII identifier shape to keep SQL splicing safe.

host.description: DB host. No implicit socket / peer auth — always explicit.

admin_user.description: Account allowed to CREATE DATABASE / CREATE USER.

admin_password.description: Admin password. Typically loaded from age-encrypted vars: `"{{ .mysql_root_pw }}"`.

user.description: Optional app user. When set, the agent also runs CREATE USER + GRANT ALL on this database.

user_host.description: Grant scope. Set to `'localhost'` to lock the account to loopback / socket.

pgDatabase.description: CREATE DATABASE via `psql` on the remote (with an existence sniff against pg_database since PG has no IF NOT EXISTS). Optionally also CREATE ROLE + GRANT ALL when `user` is set. Admin password is passed through the PGPASSWORD env var. Encoding/owner drift on an existing DB is NOT reconciled.
